concepts.title: Month calendar and account comparison
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: second design exploration of the native macOS AppKit AI Usage Stats Home window, before Swift implementation.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing native Home month/calendar concept, the edit target and source of macOS styling/navigation. Image 2 is the user's CLI proxy quota-table screenshot, a FUNCTIONAL reference for comparing multiple accounts and separate quota windows. Do not copy its video presenter, web chrome, token filenames, typography or dark web dashboard. Recompose the Home layout to improve density and information clarity.
Primary request: Home remains the selected/default window page. A calendar shows every known NEXT quota reset, as small provider icons immediately next to remaining percentages and the usage-window name. A dense flat account comparison table makes the 5-hour, weekly and model-specific limits easy to compare without hovering every account. One small native account hover flyout is visible, anchored to the Codex Work 63% 5-hour reset event.
Style: extremely crisp realistic front-facing macOS app screenshot, SF Pro system type and monospaced digits, standard traffic lights, standard sidebar, quiet functional toolbar, hairline grid and table separators, tight readable spacing, no decorative cards or pills. App window fills a wide landscape image around 1750 by 1100. Keep all text legible. No wallpaper.
Sidebar: Home selected with a native blue source-list highlight; four compact stable account rows showing icon and verified fictional email: personal@example.invalid (Claude), studio@example.invalid (Claude), work@example.invalid (Codex), codex@example.invalid (Codex). Native Add Account and App Settings actions. Use small monochrome Claude many-rayed asterisk and OpenAI six-loop knot icons for Codex, matching the existing app menu. Do not substitute robots, C letters, generic stars, chat bubbles, or colored logo capsules.
Window title AI Usage Stats. Toolbar has date navigation, Today, native Month / 2 Weeks segmented control, Refresh, and a small native account filter popup "All accounts". A plain meaning label "Remaining quota" is adjacent to the calendar/table, not a gray subtitle above a section.
Data rules: ALL percentages mean REMAINING. Data is fictional, observed at Tue Oct 13, 2026, 10:00 AM CDT. Do not invent recurring future resets, plan multipliers, forecast percentages, account-renewal claims or new providers. Retain zero as 0%, and unknown as Unknown. A missing reset timestamp says "Time unavailable", never "No reset pending". Reset credits are a count, and their expiry is separate from quota resets. Subscription expiry is not labeled renewal. This is a design proposal; live data is not displayed.
Four account-table rows, exact fictional data:
Claude Personal / personal@example.invalid / Max:
5-hour: 99% remaining; resets Today 1:00 PM (in 3 hours).
Weekly: 75% remaining; resets Thu Oct 15 9:00 AM.
Fable 5 weekly: 51% remaining; resets Thu Oct 15 9:00 AM.
Manual reset credits: Not supported.
Claude Studio / studio@example.invalid / Max:
5-hour: 100% remaining; reset Time unavailable.
Weekly: 100% remaining; resets Sat Oct 17 2:00 PM.
Fable 5 weekly: 100% remaining; resets Sat Oct 17 2:00 PM.
Manual reset credits: Not supported.
Codex Work / work@example.invalid / Pro:
5-hour: 63% remaining; resets Today 12:00 PM (in 2 hours).
Weekly: 17% remaining; resets Thu Oct 15 6:42 PM.
Fable 5 weekly: Not applicable.
Manual reset credits: 2 available; earliest expiry Tue Oct 20 10:00 AM.
Codex Personal / codex@example.invalid / Plus:
5-hour: 0% remaining; resets Today 11:00 AM (in 1 hour).
Weekly: 0% remaining; resets Fri Oct 16 5:50 PM.
Fable 5 weekly: Not applicable.
Manual reset credits: 3 available; earliest expiry Wed Oct 21 9:00 AM.
Calendar has exactly 9 reported quota reset events, no credit-expiry or subscription events:
Oct 13, in time order: Codex icon 0% 5-hour; Codex icon 63% 5-hour (hovered); Claude icon 99% 5-hour.
Oct 15: Claude icon 75% Weekly; Claude icon 51% Fable 5; Codex icon 17% Weekly.
Oct 16: Codex icon 0% Weekly.
Oct 17: Claude icon 100% Weekly; Claude icon 100% Fable 5.
All other days empty. Studio's 5-hour has no reported reset time and therefore no calendar event.
Colors are restrained and functional: 17% may use native orange with the visible text Low; 0% may use native red with the visible text Limit reached. Keep normal values neutral. State must be conveyed in readable text, not color alone. No green progress bars. Numeric values lead their cells, reset timing sits directly below; never use long lines of faint commentary.
The one functional native hover flyout, tethered tightly to Codex Work's 63% event, appears over empty calendar space and never covers the hovered event or the table. Compact aligned contents, verbatim:
Codex
work@example.invalid
Pro
5-hour             63% remaining
Resets             Today, 12:00 PM CDT
                   In 2 hours
Weekly             17% remaining
Resets             Thu, Oct 15, 6:42 PM CDT
[thin native separator]
Quota reset credits   2 available
Earliest expiry       Tue, Oct 20, 10:00 AM CDT
[thin native separator]
Updated 10:00 AM CDT
Use a small standard Open Account button at the bottom of the flyout. The pointer is over the 63% event, with just that row a subtle native hover highlight. One flyout only. No Reset Quota button: this utility observes usage.
Footer, exact text: "Example accounts · Times in CDT". No decorative statistic cards, no pill tags, no marketing header, no duplicate permanent inspector, no em dashes, no gradients, no continuous animation or spinner, no unrelated spending chart. Never label a reset-credit expiry as recovered quota.
Specific composition A: light appearance. Main content is a wide MONTH calendar ABOVE a full-width ACCOUNT COMPARISON table. Calendar occupies the upper 58% and the table the lower 42% of content, with a thin horizontal native split divider. This replaces the old right-side Upcoming resets list. The table is a native flat multi-column table, not cards, with column headers Account, 5-hour, Weekly, Fable 5 weekly, Reset credits. All four account rows are visible at once; no truncated emails or reset-credit expiry labels. Plan Max / Pro / Plus belongs in the Account cell below the email; use normal readable text. Align bold percentages by column and show reset day/time beneath them, including "Time unavailable" for Studio 5-hour. Reset-credit cells say "2 available" / "3 available" and "Expires Oct 20" / "Expires Oct 21", never a future reset or renewal. Nonapplicable model/reset cells explicitly say "Not applicable" / "Not supported".
Month is October 2026, Month selected. Calendar is correct Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat with 5 date rows: Sep 27 28 29 30 Oct 1 2 3; then 4–10; 11–17; 18–24; 25–31. Today Oct 13 has a restrained blue date marker. Calendar events are compact icon + percentage + scope, plain rows without capsules. Hover flyout is anchored to the 63% Codex Work entry in the Oct 13 cell, extending over empty Wednesday/Thursday dates ABOVE the active Oct 15 entries, leaving table and all nine quota events readable. If needed, increase image width to avoid any clipping. The table is the screenshot-inspired improvement, while the calendar remains the dominant Home content.
